messages:
kai: FYI publishbot attempted a staging promote but deploy-bot blocked it due to a provenance annotation timestamp outside the allowed TTL :hourglass:
deploy-bot: promote blocked for digest sha256:aa12...bb34 - provenance.kms_ts=2024-10-30T23:50:00Z (grace=36h)
lia: this smells like the mirrored-key rotation issue we saw last quarter — EU mirror keys rotated and attestations skewed back in time
sam: yep. options: force-retag & republish, or pin services to the last-known-good digest until republish completes. pin is lower risk for canary traffic
mel: agree pinning is less disruptive. what's the proposed coordination steps and who takes the republish?
kai: suggested plan:
- create a short change window and lock the staging lane
- pin affected services to previous digest (sha256:77f8...9010)
- ops republish corrected image to staging with a fresh cosign attestation from the mirror KMS
- retry promote and run smoke + integration checks, then unpin
- update release notes mentioning the pin and new digest
rafael: I can handle the republish (assign me the RB). I'll need temporary KMS access to the mirror key and will push to a temp repository tag first for verification
mel: assign ticket RB-4099 and post the lock to the thread
ops-bot: created ticket RB-4099 and added label "provenance-attestation"
lia: please include a label on the republished image: `provenance.mirror_region=eu-west-1` and `provenance.resynced_by=rafael` so we can filter later
sam: also add `provenance.tool=publishbot-v2` to indicate the pipeline that created the attestation
kai: lock command (deployctl):
```
deployctl lock --lane=staging --reason="provenance TTL drift; pin to prev digest" --duration=15m
```
mel: pin command (example):
```
redwoodctl service pin --service=auth-staging --digest=sha256:77f8...9010 --note="pin during provenance republish RB-4099"
```
deploy-bot: automated promote attempt 1771240000-1 blocked; created hold entry and attached RB-4099
rafael: starting republish now. pushing to staging-temp:tag-resync, will cosign with mirrored KMS key after push
(2m pass)
rafael: push complete -> new digest sha256:dd55...ccee. cosign attestation created with kms_ts=2024-11-04T07:04:00Z. uploading provenance metadata labels now
ops-bot: audit log: user=rafael action=republish target=staging-temp tag=tag-resync digest=sha256:dd55...ccee
sam: looks good. deploy-bot, please attempt promote from staging-temp to staging
deploy-bot: running promote: `promote --from=staging-temp --to=staging --keep-old=false`
deploy-bot: promote succeeded; quick smoke set: payment flow, auth handoff, background jobs - all green :white_check_mark:
kai: waiting 3m observation, then unpin and release the lock
mel: drafting release notes line: "hotfix: pinned staging to sha256:77f8...9010 during provenance republish; new image sha256:dd55...ccee promoted after resync (RB-4099)" - publishing to release-notes channel
lia: also add guidance for downstream teams: if you pin by tag, verify digest cache; clients that pull by floating tag might have stale manifest caches
sam: follow-up: ORG-2280 - add monitoring alert when mirror attestations are older than 24h post key-rotation and shorten grace to 24h for mirrored regions
mel: thanks everyone. closing this thread after RB-4099 updated and release note posted. :thumbsup:
